note: Spec 1 (6984 lines, Pipeline-Service). H2-level chunking. Several H2 sections (§4 = 30k tokens, §11 = 23k, §15 = 12k, §6 = 17k) contain multiple ###-sub-sections that map to different plan-chunks. We chose NOT to do H3->H2 promotion (preserves the spec's internal cross-references); instead each chunk's `description` + `targeted_sub_sections` field points the implementer at specific ###-level sub-sections via plan-author guidance. The plan-reader CLI gives the entire H2 section when read — the implementer narrows to the relevant ###-sub-sections during work. This is acceptable because (a) the implementer has 12-15k token budget per chunk for targeted reads and (b) each sub-section is internally cohesive.
